environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a VPC with com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint. The endpoint has a custom policy with Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalTag/environment=production AND restricting s3:GetObject to Resource arn:aws:s3:::prod-api-keys-config/data/* only. The route table associated with the Fargate subnets directs S3 prefix-list traffic through the VPC endpoint. Task networking uses awsvpc mode with security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f that has egress rules limited to the S3 prefix list (pl-63a5400a) on port 443 and the VPC CIDR on port 8080. No NAT gateway exists in the subnet route table - all S3 traffic MUST traverse the VPC endpoint. The endpoint policy denies access to the keys/ prefix entirely via an explicit Deny statement with StringLike condition on s3:prefix matching 'keys/*' when aws:SourceVpce equals vpce-0abc123def456.
